entries.why: APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #576: adds one route, /community/:tenantId/:communityId (CommunitySpacePage), directly after the reviewed /community/:tenantId route, and lets a signed-out visit to that path keep its return through the existing free signup. No original route moved and no funnel marker changed: THE-292 and the-255 assert the order by name.

APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #576: Your communities also lists the communities other than a ministry's default one that the member belongs to, read from their own users/{uid}/communityMemberships index; one they can no longer read is left out rather than failing the list.
APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #576: the firestore mock gains query/where, and one test covers the joined-community list, including the unreadable and deleted cases. Nothing removed.
APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #576: the Your communities card is keyed by its link, so two communities with the same name no longer share a React key. No markup or style change.
APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #576: the switcher's link rows are keyed by their link for the same reason. No markup or style change.

APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #576: adds communityConsentNotice, the join notice Matei approved for communities other than the default one. The default community's notice, scope and consent version are unchanged.

APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #576: a safe community return path may now name a community: /community/{tenantId}/{communityId}. Adds communitySpaceFromPath and communitySpacePath. communityIdFromPath, which scopes the default community, is unchanged and still refuses the two-segment path.

APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #576: '/community/a/extra' moved from the refused list to an accepted case, because it is now a community page; three new refusals (an extra segment, an uppercase id, a leading hyphen) take its place, and a new test covers parsing.
APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #576: records CommunitySpacePage as an adopter of the shared textarea (feed composer and chat box). Nothing removed.
APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #576: the expected route order gains /community/:tenantId/:communityId directly after the reviewed /community/:tenantId route; every original route keeps its position.
APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #576: records CommunitySpacePage, in sorted order, among the files that use the min-h-11 phone floor. Nothing removed.
APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #576: the expected route order gains /community/:tenantId/:communityId directly after the reviewed /community/:tenantId route; every original route keeps its position.
APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #576: adds a sample path for the new /community/[tenantId]/[communityId] pattern so every registered route is exercised. Nothing removed.
